{{Quote|Watch your stabilizer, Gold Six!|The clone trooper pilot|<ref name="doad" />}}
A '''clone trooper pilot''' was a member of [[Gold Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Gold Squadron]], a [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Pilot/Legends|Piloting]] a [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighter]], the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] participated in a [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|battle]] in the [[Both system]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], Gold Squadron, including the [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilot]], departed from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']], intending to combat a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]] led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. During the battle, the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] told fellow pilot [[Gold Six (clone trooper)/Legends|Gold Six]] to watch his [[Stabilizer/Legends|stabilizer]]. As the starfighter unit took casualties from Confederate [[Laser/Legends|laser]] fire, Skywalker ordered Gold Squadron to retreat while he continued toward the [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]]. Grievous' fleet was eventually destroyed by [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] hidden in the [[Golm asteroid belt|asteroid belt]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Gold Squadron, take evasive actions!|General Anakin Skywalker, ordering Gold Squadron to retreat during the battle|<ref name="doad" />}}
A [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]]<ref name="doad" /> was born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], created to fight in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="db" /> The [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] was assigned to the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] [[Gold Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]].<ref name="doad" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref><ref name="Gambit: Stealth">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]''</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] planned to invade the planet [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], home of the native [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]]. However, the Republic became aware of the plans, and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], along with a [[Battle group/Legends|battle group]] consisting of three [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]], were sent to protect the Bothan [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="ws">''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]''</ref> Even though the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic forces]] were outnumbered, Skywalker persisted in protecting the [[Both system]] from a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of Confederate [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]] commanded by Grievous. Skywalker placed several [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcers]] on [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] in the<ref name="doad" /> [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Golm|Bothawui Prime's]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Golm asteroid belt|asteroid belt]], planning to attack the Confederate [[Starship/Legends|ships]] from behind.<ref name="doad" />

[[File:Munificents_emerge.png|thumb|left|250px|The Confederate frigates emerge from the asteroid field.]]
After the Confederate [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] emerged from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], Grievous ordered his ships to navigate through the Bothawui [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]], as the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] General planned to use the asteroids to cover his ships from Republic [[Laser/Legends|laser]] fire. Led by Skywalker in his [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B interceptor]], the clone pilot&mdash;wearing [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|clone trooper armor]] with [[Color/Legends|yellow]] markings&mdash;and the rest of Gold Squadron departed from the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]<ref name="doad" /> [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']]<ref name="ws" /> in [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] General led the clone pilots toward the approaching Confederate frigates but ordered Gold Squadron to hold positions, as he wanted the enemy ships to come closer so that the AT-TEs on the asteroids could [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|attack]] them from behind. On Grievous' command, the frigates opened fire, causing damage to one of the Republic Star Destroyers. Just before one of Gold Squadron's starfighters was hit by laser fire, causing it to crash into another starfighter, the clone [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] pilot told [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmate]] [[Gold Six (clone trooper)/Legends|Gold Six]] to watch his [[Stabilizer/Legends|stabilizer]]. As the squadron took casualties from laser fire, Skywalker ordered the group to retreat, while he continued the assault on the approaching Confederate ships. Grievous' frigates were attacked by the Republic [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] from behind, eventually leading to the destruction of his fleet. However, Grievous himself was able to escape the battle.<ref name="doad" />

==Personality and traits==
Created from the [[Gene/Legends|genetic]] template of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]],<ref name="db" /> the clone trooper pilot<ref name="doad" /> was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who stood at a height of 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]<ref name="db" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" />

==Behind the scenes==
The clone trooper pilot was briefly seen in the sixth episode of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' television series']] [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]], "[[Downfall of a Droid]]." In the episode, which aired on [[November 7]], [[2008]], the clone was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]].<ref name="epguide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode006.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Downfall of a Droid}}</ref>
